dialogues.speaker: Vadim
dialogues.text: Boss, that kid over there must be staring at us... It feels so strange to be stared at... It feels like all the hairs on my body are getting knotted up...

dialogues.speaker: Pasha
dialogues.text: You moron! There you go with the bad analogies again! There's not a single knot to be found on you! Not with that smooth, glossy coat of yours!

dialogues.speaker: Pasha
dialogues.text: But! As one of Snezhnograd's pro detectives, I deduce that this skinny little kid is following us.

dialogues.speaker: Pasha
dialogues.text: We must be on our guard. One of our competitors could have sent him to spy on us.

dialogues.speaker: Vadim
dialogues.text: How astute of you, Boss... but if I may offer a suggestion... maybe we can find ourselves a hidden spot for a while, until he stops following us.

dialogues.speaker: Pasha
dialogues.text: The more you seek out somewhere hidden, the more suspicion you draw to yourself. On the other hand, you're far more difficult to spot when you move in a crowd... You imbecile! How many times do I have to teach you something like this???

dialogues.speaker: Vadim
dialogues.text: Oof. Then I'll just have to get used to being stared at, I guess... I get it now, Boss. What are we doing next?

dialogues.speaker: Pasha
dialogues.text: Pfft. At a time like this, of course it's better to take the offensive. That'd catch your opponent when they least expect it!
